invariants.description: rate law (relative 1e-9): J = jmax m A_mem f_PEP (C_e ATP - G6P ADP/K_eq)/((K_m_ATP + ATP)(K + C_e)), f_PEP = ADP/(K_ADP_PEP + ADP) Pi/(K_Pi_PEP + Pi), K_eq = exp(-dG0_hk/RT)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(J_glc, jmax_glc*m_expr*A_mem*ADP/(K_ADP_PEP + ADP)*Pi/(K_Pi_PEP + Pi)*(C_glc_e*ATP - C_G6P*ADP*np.exp(dG0_hk/(R*T)))/((K_m_ATP + ATP)*(K_glc_t + C_glc_e)), rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12*abs(jmax_glc*A_mem*max(m_expr, 1e-30)))

invariants.description: stoichiometry (exact): glucose leaves the medium and arrives as G6P, one ATP equivalent becomes ADP per glucose and no Pi is released; lactate does not cross
invariants.expr: np.array_equal(J_glc_e, -J_glc) and np.array_equal(J_G6P, J_glc) and np.array_equal(J_ATP_cost, J_glc) and np.array_equal(j_ATP, -J_glc) and np.array_equal(j_ADP, J_glc) and np.all(j_Pi == 0) and np.all(J_lac_e == 0)

invariants.description: second law: glucose moves down the affinity of the coupled reaction, J A >= 0, A = RT ln(K_eq C_e ATP/(G6P ADP))

bc_sweep.rationale: glucose outside from 0.1 uM to 50 mM (the game's range, both sides of the Km), G6P inside from none to a real cell's ~10 mM, ATP from exhaustion (where the carrier can run backwards) to above rest, expression from none to the game's maximum
